entities.name: Web3D Consortium

entities.name: ACM SIGGRAPH
entities.note: The Association for Computing Machinery's Special Interest Group on Computer Graphics and Interactive Techniques.

entities.name: Khronos Group
entities.note: An open consortium of companies creating advanced interoperability standards for 3D graphics, including glTF.

entities.name: W3C
entities.note: The World Wide Web Consortium, the main international standards organization for the World Wide Web.

entities.name: Metaverse Standards Forum
entities.note: A forum fostering interoperability standards for an open metaverse.

entities.name: AOUSD
